::: {.info-card}
Welcome. I'm an undergraduate researcher working at the intersection of **computational commutative algebra** and **graph theory**, advised by Professor Sosa-Castillo. My current work investigates properties of simple finite graphs under monomial orders, with an emphasis on formal proof-writing at a publication standard.

This site also hosts my coursework from **Math 240: Computational Statistics**.
:::

## Research

I study connections between graph-theoretic structure and algebraic properties of monomial ideals — particularly how combinatorial data from a graph translates into algebraic invariants. This work is deeply collaborative and has sharpened my ability to communicate mathematics clearly and rigorously.
